mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where ISM < 50.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the yield curve inverts, with the 10-year Treasury yield falling below the 2-year yield, it signals an impending recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where the yield curve inverts.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall by more than 10% year-over-year, signaling a weakening housing market, and the unemployment rate is already above 6%, signaling a weak labor market, the combination drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST y/y growth < -10% and UNRATE > 6%.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index rises above 60, indicating a strong manufacturing expansion, and the unemployment rate is below 4%, indicating a tight labor market, the combination signals an overheating economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where ISM > 60 and UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, signaling a restrictive monetary policy, and the yield curve is inverted, signaling an impending recession, the combination drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and DGS10 < DGS2.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending (PCE) growth accelerates by more than 5% year-over-year, signaling strong consumer demand, and the ISM non-manufacturing index is above 55, signaling strong service sector activity, the combination drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where PCE y/y growth > 5% and ISM non-mfg > 55.
